name: expired-jobs-checker
title: Expired Jobs Checker — Is This Job Posting Still Open?
description: Check if job postings are still open or closed/expired: paste job IDs or job URLs (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Personio, Teamtailor, Workable, Recruitee) and get open/closed per job from a daily index.

input.description: The job_id or job URL exactly as given

job_id.description: factpipe job_id (ats:board:posting_id) of the input; null when the input is not a recognisable job

status.description: open: listed in today's index; closed: its board is in today's index and the job is not; unknown: the index cannot tell (see status_reason)

status_reason.description: in_index / duplicate_in_index (listed under another job_id) -> open; not_in_index -> closed; board_partially_indexed (the board lists more jobs than the nightly build keeps), board_not_in_index, unrecognized_input, not_checked (run stopped) -> unknown

last_seen_index_built_at.description: Build time of the index that lists the job (open rows); null otherwise

title.description: Job title (open rows only: a closed job's title is not in the index any more)

job_url.description: Job page (open rows: from the index; URL inputs: as given)

checked_at.description: When this run checked the job

source_url.description: open/closed: the ATS API or feed URL the index read the board from; unknown: the index manifest

fetched_at.description: When the nightly build read the board (open/closed), or the index build time (unknown)
